runtime_basis: Original 1655 MG94 fits consumed 1.0417 summed worker-hours (median 1.95 s, maximum 20.87 s per case). Eight refits per case plus fresh readback and tighter optimization; conservative 1–24 wall-hour allowance with four workers.
starts: Every point starts independently from the original saved model; no warm starts across points. Single-start optimized likelihoods may remain below the global profile maximum.
cost: Existing authorized host; no new charges
interpretation: Profiles of the saved MG94 branch t parameter, reoptimizing remaining free branch parameters, five exchangeabilities and global omega. Empirical CF3x4 frequencies, genetic code, alignment and topology remain fixed. Because exchangeabilities change, original dS is a case-review label, not the profiled parameter or a dS confidence interval. Finite grid and single-start optimization do not establish global maxima, absence of saturation, calibrated confidence intervals, biological eligibility or selection.
